title: Type filters and search
preconditions: Open `map.html` on **Specific Map**. Pick a known seed animal (e.g. **African Lion** or **Raccoon**).
dateUnderTest: Any Specific Map date where the chosen animal is in seed.

steps.name: Animals checked by default
steps.expect: **Animals** checkbox is checked; other types are unchecked by default.

steps.name: Uncheck Animals
steps.expect: Animal markers disappear from the map.

steps.name: Enable Restaurants
steps.expect: Restaurant markers appear (in addition to animals).

steps.name: Spot-check another type
steps.expect: Corresponding markers show/hide without breaking Animals.

steps.name: Search query
steps.do: In **Search animals** / Search… field, type part of the known species name.
steps.expect: Results list under the search field populates.

steps.name: Select search result
steps.do: Click **View on Map** on a search result.
steps.expect: Map pans/focuses to that animal’s marker.

steps.name: Tooltip opens on focus
steps.do: Look at the focused animal marker after **View on Map**.
steps.expect: That animal’s tooltip opens on the focused marker.

steps.name: Clear via uncheck Animals
steps.do: Uncheck **Animals** while search results are visible.
steps.expect: Search results clear or animal results are removed as designed.

steps.name: Restore search
steps.expect: Search works again and can focus a marker.
